description: Native Spec-Driven Development fleet dashboard inside Paca (ADR-038): eight team-wide views (overview, task board, sessions, activity, analytics, coordination, SDD phases, machine fleet) rendered as Module Federation components with a left sub-rail and dependency-free inline-SVG cards/tables/timelines. Reads the SDD Coordination Server same-origin through the /sdd-api gateway proxy — no iframe, no chart libraries, no secrets.
